# GitHub Sponsors Configuration

## Sponsorship Tiers

### 🌟 Supporter - $5/month
- Thank you message
- Access to supporter Discord channel
- Early access to new features
- Monthly newsletter

### 💎 Sponsor - $25/month
- Everything in Supporter
- Priority support
- Access to beta features
- Monthly live Q&A sessions
- Sponsor badge on GitHub

### 🏆 Champion - $100/month
- Everything in Sponsor
- Direct access to core team
- Custom feature requests
- Monthly 1-on-1 calls
- Champion badge on GitHub

### 🚀 Enterprise - $500/month
- Everything in Champion
- Custom integrations
- Dedicated support channel
- Quarterly strategy sessions
- Enterprise badge on GitHub

## Benefits

- 🎯 **Direct Impact**: Your sponsorship directly supports development
- 🚀 **Priority Access**: Get early access to new features
- 💬 **Community**: Join our exclusive sponsor community
- 🎓 **Learning**: Access to educational content and resources
- 🏆 **Recognition**: Public recognition for your support

## How to Sponsor

1. Visit our [GitHub Sponsors page](https://github.com/sponsors/coinbalance)
2. Choose your sponsorship tier
3. Complete the sponsorship process
4. Start enjoying your benefits!
